name: f01-any-whitespace-blank-class
clause: R1 'leading spaces/tabs' / 'trailing spaces/tabs' blank class: strips every whitespace character (str.strip(None)), not only spaces and tabs

name: f02-panic-value-prefix-no
clause: R6 'value equal to `no` case-insensitively': accepts any value starting with 'no' (none, no2) as the prompt setting
anchor: elif panic is not None and panic[1].lower() == "no":

name: f03-optional-missing-skip
clause: R6 'LP-MISSING and LP-UNRESOLVED -> not-modelled': optional keys with a missing file consequence 'skip' instead of 'not-modelled'

name: f04-optional-term-font-dropped
clause: R6 'key wallpaper or term_font (optional resources) -> skip': term_font is no longer optional (mirror of roster m27, which drops wallpaper)

name: f05-hash-128-any-chars
clause: R3 'exactly 128 characters of [0-9a-fA-F]': length checked, character set not (any 128 characters accepted as a well-formed hash)
anchor: if len(h) != 128 or not set(h) <= HEXDIGITS:

name: f06-empty-pin-list-cannot-evaluate
clause: R7 'else HEALTHY rc 0': a conf with no pin records reads CANNOT-EVALUATE rc 2

name: f07-dollar-lstrip-all
clause: R4 'a leading $ (gzip marker) is dropped from the resource': every leading '$' is dropped, not exactly one

name: f08-entry-label-trailing-plus
clause: R8 'without a leading +, trimmed': a trailing '+' is also stripped from the reported entry label

name: f09-entry-null-as-empty-string
clause: R8 'or null before any entry line': a pin before the first entry line reports entry "" instead of null

name: f10-entry-first-not-nearest
clause: R8 'the label of the nearest preceding entry line': the first entry line's label is used for every later pin

name: f11-entry-requires-column-zero
clause: R8 'a line whose first non-blank character is /': only a line starting at column 0 counts as an entry line (leading blanks ignored)

name: f12-panic-value-raw-trailing-blanks
clause: R8 'value: its R1 value': the reported hash_mismatch_panic value keeps the line's trailing spaces/tabs (R1 strips them)

name: f13-unhashed-uri-reports-format
clause: R2 'a value with no # after ):/ ... is not a pin and is ignored': a URI-form value with no '#' becomes a pin with an empty hash (LP-HASH-FORMAT)

name: f14-cr-stripped-only-trailing
clause: R1 'strip CR ... per line' / 'trailing ... CR removed': only a trailing CR is removed; a mid-line CR survives into the value

name: f15-esp-join-no-separator
clause: R4 'resolves to ESP/path': the ESP and the path are concatenated without a separator (ESP + path instead of ESP/path)

name: f16-optional-unresolved-skip
clause: R6 'LP-MISSING and LP-UNRESOLVED -> not-modelled': optional keys with an unresolved resource consequence 'skip' instead of 'not-modelled'

name: f17-entry-one-leading-slash
clause: R8 'the line without its leading / characters': only one leading '/' is removed from the entry label

name: f18-resource-case-insensitive
clause: R4 'resource `boot` with an empty root resolves': the resource name is lower-cased before the comparison, so BOOT/Boot resolve too

name: f19-entry-label-not-trimmed
clause: R8 label '..., trimmed': the whitespace after the leading '/'/'+' is kept in the reported entry label

name: ctl-meta-value-lie
clause: control: hash_mismatch_panic value is a lie (+'!') wherever the field is emitted; proves whether the battery asserts R8 metadata values

name: ctl-entry-label-lie
clause: control: every emitted entry label is a lie (+'!'); proves whether the battery asserts R8 entry labels
